newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Late Taiwan stocks remain higher on constructions.
newsitem.headline: Late Taiwan stocks remain higher on constructions.

text.p: Taiwan share prices remained higher in late Friday trade, boosted by strong buying in laggard construction shares, brokers said.
With 40 minutes to go, at 0320 GMT, the weighted index had gained 115.78 points or 1.31 percent at 8,987.54.
Turnover was an active T$135 billion.
Brokers said the government's recent cool-off moves only had a minor impact on the market's bullish sentiment.
"Investors are very confident about the market's outlooks," United Securities analyst Lin Long-hsien said.
"The government's recent efforts to cool down the red hot stock market may have some effect on short-term oriented investors, but not on longer-term investors," Lin said.
Brokers expected the market to continue to challenge the key resistance at 9,000 points.
